modelOverview: The Royal Oak Selfwinding Chronograph 41mm (reference 26240) was introduced in 2022 to mark the 50th anniversary of the Royal Oak, replacing the outgoing 26331 with a fresh in-house movement and a refined single-colour dial layout. It pairs Gerald Genta's iconic octagonal bezel and integrated bracelet with the latest-generation Calibre 4401 flyback chronograph. The reference spans steel, precious-metal and full-ceramic executions, making it one of the most versatile complicated Royal Oaks in the current collection.
